evidence: as a result of the broad scale release and availability of AI technologies such as generative AI, there is a global trend towards more regulation (e.g., the EU AI Act and AI laws passed in U.S. states) to ensure the ethical use, privacy, and security of AI and the data that it processes
Compliance with such laws will likely be an increasing and substantial cost in the future
ai_positioning.summary: Jazz Pharmaceuticals adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, se concentrant sur les risques réglementaires et les coûts de conformité liés à la généralisation des technologies d'IA générative, sans mention d'initiatives propres d'intégration ou de développement IA.
